method: Agent visual inspection of four final saved actual viewport screenshots; automated layout and recovery assertions cover all seven screenshots.
observations: Web binding table shows both synthetic platforms, readable AppIDs, status and revoke actions. The visible MFA input is empty.
Taro H5 dark view shows both complete binding cards, readable timestamps, revoke and refresh actions without horizontal clipping.
The narrow Web viewport contains the binding table in its horizontal scroll region; action columns require horizontal scrolling.
The Taro lost-response view retains the connection message while the refreshed list explicitly shows the revoked binding and timestamp. Other active binding and refresh actions remain visible.
scope: Synthetic local Web and Taro H5 views, not real mini-program or device acceptance. The Web viewport is scrolled to the binding feature.
